question: Why is the engine overheating?
raw:
**Troubleshooting table**
• Cause: Check for debris blocking radiator fins -> Action: Remove debris [Manual page 288]
• Cause: Allow engine to cool and check for low coolant level -> Action: Add coolant as necessary [Manual page 288]
• Cause: Check for broken or missing fan belts -> Action: Notify unit maintenance if belts are broken or missing [Manual page 288]
• Cause: Check to see if fan is running -> Action: If fan is not running, perform emergency fan clutch override procedure [Manual page 288]

**Other relevant information**
• Stop engine if coolant temperature gauge suddenly increases beyond approximately 230°F (110°C) [Manual page 209]
• Notify unit maintenance to check differential, T-case, and transmission fluids for “oil breakdown” caused by overheating [Manual page 209]

**Limitations**
The troubleshooting table lists possible causes and does not diagnose this specific vehicle or machine. Recommended authorized technical support for repairs.
